params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Xin Zhao's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ais|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}}'' first slash hit and thrust on at least one enemy hit each generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Determination'', stacking up to 3 times. The third stack {{tt|consumes them|See notes for consumption details}} all to deal {{as|{{pp|15 to 60 for 4|key=%|1 to 16|formula=15% + 15% every 5 levels}} AD}} {{as|(+ {{pp|5 to 20 for 4|1;6;11;16|key=%}} AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|heal}} '''Xin Zhao''' for {{as|{{pp|2 to 5|key=%|1;6;11}} of his '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{pp|40;50;70|1;6;11|key=%}} AP)}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Challenge:}} ''{{ai|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}}'' and, if ''{{ai|Crescent Guard|Xin Zhao}}'' has been learned, '''Xin Zhao's''' basic attacks and ''{{ai|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}}'', apply a {{as|Challenged|buzzword}} mark to certain enemies hit for 3 seconds. Only one enemy can be marked as {{as|Challenged|buzzword}} at a time; applying the mark to a new target removes it from the previous one. ''{{ai|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}}'' and ''{{ai|Crescent Guard|Xin Zhao}}'' have interactions against {{as|Challenged|buzzword}} targets.
params.notes:
;Determination Details
* The ''healing'' and '''bonus''' damage work on different stacking systems, each counting its stacks and being consumed separately. While both stack {{tip|on-hit}}, the '''bonus''' damage stacks are consumed {{tip|on-attack}}, and the healing ones {{tip|on-hit}}.
** The ''healing'' stacks are denoted in the buff-bar.
** If {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} were to trigger when the stacks are at maximum, they will grant the healing but not the '''bonus''' damage, thus causing an out-of-sync between the stacks shown in-game versus when the '''bonus''' damage is dealt.
* Only the initial slash of {{ai|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}} can generate a ''Determination'' stack. Slashes after the first do not count for stack generation.
* The stack counter displays 1–3 rather than the usual 0–2, meaning that a count of 1 does not translate to having 1 stack.
* Stacks reset when '''Xin Zhao''' {{tip|death|dies}}.
* Stacks of ''Determination'' will be gained even if the attack is {{tip|blocked}}.
* {{Pending for test}}: ''Determination's'' interaction with ''parrying'' effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|blind}}).
* ''Determination'' deals {{tip|proc damage}}.
** Since it is a separate instance of damage when applied by basic attack or either of {{ais|W|Xin Zhao}} strikes, flat damage reduction that applies to both the main and bonus damage such as {{cais|Tantrum|Amumu}} passive will reduce each, for twice the reduction.
** The bonus damage cannot {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}}.
* When applied by a basic attack:
** The attack uses a unique animation.
** The bonus damage benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
*** {{pending for test}} It {{tip|applies life steal}} specifically.
** Neither the bonus damage or heal will be blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.
* When applied by {{ai|W|Xin Zhao}}:
** Triggers against the closest target struck by the first slash/thrust (equals first target to receive spell effects).
** Does not benefit from {{sti|life steal}}, including not healing from ''Wind Becomes Lightning's'' 33% conversion for this bonus damage.
** Since {{tip|proc damage}} is 'single target', {{tip|drain|Vamp}} will heal from 100% of the bonus damage.
** The bonus damage will be blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}, the heal will not.
;Challenged Details
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the mark application from {{ai|W|Xin Zhao}}, but not from basic attacks and {{ai|E|Xin Zhao}}.
* 
<!--Blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Xin Zhao}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}}'' strikes generate a stack of ''Determination'', stacking up to 3 times.
params.blurb2: Upon generating the final stack, '''Xin Zhao''' consumes them to {{tip|heal}} himself and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Innate:}} ''{{ais|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}}'' final thrust marks enemies as [[File:Xin Zhao Challenged Mark.png|24px|link=]]{{as|Challenged|buzzword}} for a few seconds. If {{ai|Crescent Guard|Xin Zhao}} has been learned, '''Xin Zhao's''' basic attacks and {{ai|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}} also apply the mark. His abilities have special interactions against [[File:Xin Zhao Challenged Mark.png|24px|link=]]{{as|Challenged|buzzword}} targets.

Each attack refreshes the duration.

params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Xin Zhao''' unleashes {{tt|4 slashes|First slash happens on-cast instantly, while the remaining 3 are applied every 0.05 seconds thereafter}} in an arc over the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds of the cast time, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within. After the remaining cast time, he then thrusts his spear in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|0 to 33.3 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.33 * critical strike chance}}|critical chance}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% for {{fd|1.5}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}} per 100 AP)}} seconds. ''Wind Becomes Lightning'' deals {{pp|50 to 100 for 16|key=%}} damage to {{tip|minions}}.

The farthest {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} hit within the thrust's area is also marked as ''{{ai|Challenged|Xin Zhao|border=false}}'' and is {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 3 seconds.
params.description2: ''Wind Becomes Lightning's'' damage {{tip|healing|heals}} '''Xin Zhao''' for {{fd|33.{{recurring|3}}}}% of his {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
params.description3:
''The durations of {{ai|Three Talon Strike|Xin Zhao}} and {{ais|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} are delayed relative to Wind Becomes Lightning's cast time.
'''Xin Zhao''' {{tip|sight|reveals}} himself during the cast if there is an enemy champion {{tt|nearby|see details}}''.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|275|Slash semi-circle radius}}|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|125|Slash and thrust extra check radius}}}}
params.range: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|1000|Thrust range}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|940|Maximum possible range; See notes}}}}
params.notes:
* {{pending for test}} The self-reveal has not been fully tested for complete confirmation. Is the ability invisible when hitting minions and there is no enemy champion nearby? Is the tip of the ability enough to reveal him? Whether it can hit a minion or not? Just if he's around the exit of the fog of war, and even if he points towards the inside of the fog of war? [https://youtu.be/GvLedSeuQ0s]
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block both the slashes and the thrust.
** If the spell shield blocks the first, or {{tt|sometimes|inconsistent}} the second slash, it will block the rest of the ability, including the thrust. If it is activated after the first slash, it will only block up to 2 slashes and will not block the trust.{{bug}}
{{Effect at cast time end}}
** The thrust will occur from wherever '''Xin Zhao''' is at the end of the cast time.
** The slashes will occur from wherever '''Xin Zhao''' is at the time during the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds.
* ''Wind Becomes Lightning'' maintains its casting angle direction in relation to '''Xin Zhao''' if he moves during the cast time.
** The direction of the slashes will not move during the cast time.
* The first strike's hitbox includes a {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 275 radius 160° cone in front of '''Xin Zhao''' and an additional {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 125 radius around him.
* The second strike's hitbox includes the same {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 125 radius around '''Xin Zhao''', a missile with {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1000 range and {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 80 total width, and a {{tip|er|icononly = true}} -60 radius area check upon the end of the missile.
** The 125 radius check does not hit [[champion summoned units]].{{bug|2}}
* Because ''Wind Becomes Lightning'' uses an older type of 'healing based on life steal' and not ''{{tip|applies life steal}}'', {{ii|Spirit Visage}} will amplify the life gain twice (+25% life steal and +25% healing), for a total of +{{fd|56.25}}%.<!--PFT: Still true?-->
* Each of ''Wind Becomes Lightning's'' slashes are applied in a separate damage instance from each other.
** This causes effects like {{ri|Bone Plating}} to be applied twice and {{iis|Black Cleaver}} {{nie|Carve}} to be applied multiple times.
<!--Blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Xin Zhao}} slashes in an arc, then thrusts his spear in a line in the target direction. Each strike deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and heals '''Xin Zhao''' based on his {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
